primary_reads.title: Martin Lohmann, Single Scale Cluster Expansions with Applications to Many Boson and Unbounded Spin Systems
primary_reads.coverage: Returned introduction/abstract lines49-75; full returned passage324-381 around Sections2.1.3-2.2; returned Section3 passage497-531. Additional find output supplied scattered later application passages, not a complete theorem/proof read.
primary_reads.use: The Gaussian derivative identity admits weak derivatives for piecewise smooth compact functions. The interaction/activity estimates explicitly use field-analytic norms. This suggests derivative and boundary organization but does not establish the present bounded-buffer insertion norm.
primary_reads.not_imported: No application to the actual compact-core ratios, no source-local normalized gas, no continuum theorem.

primary_reads.title: A. Abdesselam and V. Rivasseau, Trees, forests and jungles: a botanical garden for cluster expansions
primary_reads.coverage: arXiv abstract/submission metadata; returned HTML16-79, Gaussian find snippets, and full returned330-372 around positivity preservation and SectionV.A. No complete paper read.
primary_reads.use: The Gaussian example obtains polymer factorization from positive covariance interpolation and local interactions, with field derivatives in its forest formula. The combinatorial identity is not itself a uniform bound for our nonanalytic buffer insertions.
primary_reads.not_imported: No new BKAR theorem, Gaussian insertion estimate or Yang-Mills result adopted from this bounded read.

primary_reads.title: A. Abdesselam and V. Rivasseau, An Explicit Large Versus Small Field Multiscale Cluster Expansion
primary_reads.coverage: Search abstract; returned HTML42-67, full returned162-214, and scattered smooth-selector find snippets. Section3 polymer proof was not read in full.
primary_reads.use: The worked model is infrared scalar phi4 in four dimensions. Its large/small decomposition starts with smooth selectors and its displayed interpolation differentiates fields. This is a localization reference, not a ready proof for sharp SU(N) histories or bounded compact-return coefficients.
primary_reads.not_imported: No scalar polymer bound transferred to the nonabelian normalized-kernel law.

primary_reads.title: Daniel Ueltschi, Cluster expansions and correlation functions
primary_reads.use: A general cluster expansion with correlation estimates and a Kotecky-Preiss type convergence assumption is a possible downstream reference. The present work must first construct the required activities and prove their norms.
primary_reads.not_imported: No theorem hypotheses or proof were checked from the abstract.

primary_reads.title: A. Abdesselam, A. Procacci and B. Scoppola, Clustering bounds on n-point correlations for unbounded spin systems
primary_reads.version: v1, 29 January 2009; sole version listed by the checked arXiv metadata
primary_reads.coverage: Abstract/version metadata and returned HTML lines 35–221: full introduction, model and main statements, basic Gaussian setup and start of tree analysis. The 50-page proof was not read. An attempted v2 URL returned 404 and supplied no evidence.
primary_reads.use: The stated model has a positive quartic self-interaction and a Hermitian finite-range pair kernel with J(0)>sum_{x!=0}|J(x)|. Its conclusions concern field cumulants. These are relevant methodological comparisons; neither that diagonal-dominance hypothesis nor the bounded-buffer insertion theorem is supplied for the present source.
primary_reads.not_imported: No near-Gaussian clustering theorem applied to the actual SU(N) chart or its compact-return insertions.
